newsitem.title: POLAND: Mostostal-Export to buy four firms in 97.
newsitem.headline: Mostostal-Export to buy four firms in 97.

text.p: Polish construction and trading firm Mostostal Export SA wants to buy four firms this year, two of them builders, the company's president told the daily Parkiet in its Wednesday edition.
"In our investment plans this year we see a broadening of our holding by four firms, two of them from the construction sector," Michal Skipietrow was quoted as saying. He gave no other details.
Skipietrow said the firm wanted to list 10 of its subsidiaries in the next three years and that five would have prospectuses in the Polish Securities Commission (KPW) by the end of June 1997.
